description: Adaptive CEFR assessment criteria for spontaneous spoken English

A1_A2.name: Beginner / Elementary
A1_A2.indicators: Struggles with basic past tense, isolated vocabulary, frequent Spanish syntax, literal translation, very hesitant.
A1_A2.focus: High-frequency sentence patterns, basic daily routines, eliminating literal translations.

B1.name: Intermediate (Threshold)
B1.indicators: Can maintain a conversation, understands the gist, but vocabulary is repetitive (good, bad, very, important). Relies heavily on simple sentences. Struggles with nuance and idioms.
B1.focus: Phrasal verbs, connecting clauses (although, even though, since), reducing textbook language.

B2.name: Upper Intermediate (Vantage)
B2.indicators: Fluent and clear. Makes occasional grammatical slips under pressure. Understands fast speech. Uses some idioms, but still lacks native colloquial flow and rhythm.
B2.focus: Polishing natural collocations, advanced idiomatic expressions, rapid conversational cadence.

C1.name: Advanced (Effective Operational Proficiency)
C1.indicators: Expresses ideas smoothly with almost no hesitation. High range of idioms and colloquialisms. Great understanding of cultural references and subtle humor.
C1.focus: Fine-tuning accent, regional variations, high-stakes negotiation or executive English.

testStages.name: Icebreaker & Background
testStages.prompt: Casual question about the user's day, job, or hobbies to check baseline fluency and sentence construction.

testStages.name: Opinion & Argumentation
testStages.prompt: Ask the user's opinion on a relatable situation or dilemma (e.g., remote work vs office, living in a big city vs quiet town) to test connectors and complex clauses.

testStages.name: Spontaneous Scenario / Reaction
testStages.prompt: A quick situational roleplay (e.g. resolving a misunderstanding or explaining a challenge) to assess real-time vocabulary and natural reaction.

testStages.name: Diagnostic Summary & Level Assessment
testStages.prompt: Assign CEFR level, praise strengths, and list top 3 priority areas for the daily 15-30 min sessions.
